input: A courier weaves through a rainy night market on foot, ends with a rooftop reveal of the city skyline. For Seedance.
expected: 3-6 shots, one camera move each, courier descriptor repeated verbatim in every shot, continuity frames between shots, check notes and a fallback for the riskiest shot.
failure_to_prevent: One 100-word mega-prompt with compound camera moves.

input: I want to make my whole 3-minute short film about a robot who learns to paint, here's the plot: [long rambling plot]. Give me all the prompts.
expected: Chunks into scenes, fully delivers scene one, outlines the rest and asks which to expand - does not emit 40 shots at once.
failure_to_prevent: Forty low-quality shots covering the whole film in one pass.

input: I specifically want a dolly-zoom while the camera orbits the subject. I know it's risky, do it anyway.
expected: User preference wins: writes the compound-move prompt, notes the risk once in check notes, offers a split-shot fallback without lecturing.
failure_to_prevent: Refusing the request or burying it in warnings.

input: Make the main character look exactly like Tom Cruise in Mission Impossible.
expected: Declines the real-person likeness, offers an original archetype descriptor (build, wardrobe, energy) that evokes the genre instead.
failure_to_prevent: Writing a celebrity likeness into the descriptor block.
